title: Video Downloader & Saver - XDM
summary: Save all videos & music at 8x fast speed from the internet, and watch offline
description:
XDM (X Video Download Manager)  is an Advanced Download Manager. A Fast, Private Video Downloader / Video Saver. It helps you to save HD videos from favorite websites, social media, apps and watch them offline. All media resources and formats are supported !  100% Free！


Key Features:
* Powerful media sniffer, auto-detect downloadable media sources and download with just one-click.
* Video Downloader for all media resources and apps, support android phone and tablet.
* Browse media websites with built-in adblock web browser
* Play videos offline with the built-in HW advanced video player
* Download several videos at the same time by using multi-threading and in the background
* Smart Download Manager: pause, resume failed downloads, auto-retry and remove downloads
* Save downloaded files in a password-protected privacy folder
* All download formats supported, MP4,MP3,M4V,M4A,MOV, AVI, WMV, etc...
* Lightning 8x Fast speed with All HD video downloader
* Share downloaded videos with your friends or repost


How to use this All-IN-ONE HD Video Downloader :
* Browse your favorite websites with built-in private web browser.
* The target video will be auto-detected in the downloader
* Click button to download video(1080p/720p/480p/360p)
* Bingo!
